In an election in Maharashtra, the government allegedly changed the rules after the BJP-led alliance faced defeat, effectively stripping them of their majority. This accusation has been leveled by the opposition Congress party. Leader of the Opposition and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi has accused the BJP of altering the rules post-election to snatch away the majority in the election for Maharashtra’s Gokul Dairy. He has described this as a theft of the votes cast by milk producers. Find out what the entire matter is about in this report.
